messages:
marina: trying to install redwoodctl on my linux workstation, brew from linuxbrew. installer finished but `redwoodctl` not in PATH. zsh hook wasn't added. anyone seen this?
eli: did you run `eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"`? brew on linux needs that.
marina: yup tried that. `which redwoodctl` returns nothing. installed to /home/marina/.redwood/bin instead? installer printed: "installed to $REDWOODCTL_HOME/bin"
samir: oh the new installer respects REDWOODCTL_HOME env var. did you set it?
marina: i didn't. it defaulted to ~/.redwood but my shell looks at ~/.local/bin only.
priya: two issues: shell hook for autocompletion not linked, and login via device flow failing behind corp proxy.
marina: for device flow, `redwoodctl login --device-code` opens browser but browser times out behind proxy. CLI prints: "failed to start device flow: dial tcp: lookup auth.redwood.ai: no such host"
eli: add env HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,auth.redwood.ai ?
samir: windows/wsl folks also hit token refresh not prompting. we should auto-fallback to device flow on refresh failure. current behavior is just exit with non-zero and leave app hanging.
devx-bot: triage steps: 1) check REDWOODCTL_HOME and add $REDWOODCTL_HOME/bin to PATH; 2) run `redwoodctl install-shellhook --shell zsh`; 3) for proxies, set HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY for auth.redwood.ai; 4) to force device flow without browser: `redwoodctl login --device-code --headless`; 5) if token refresh fails, run `redwoodctl auth refresh --force` and file an issue with `redwoodctl doctor --collect`
priya: repro steps added to GH issue #4821 with logs. i attached `~/.redwood/telemetry.log` snippet.
marina: workarounds worked (added REDWOODCTL_HOME and ran install-shellhook). still think UX could be smoother: post-install prompt to add PATH + test login and an explicit note about proxies.
samir: agree. i'll pick up a small DX task to add a post-install check and a retry path that triggers device flow if refresh 401s.
eli: thanks, pls link PR when ready. :thumbsup:
